review_candidates.title: Senior Professional, Regional WAN
review_candidates.description_excerpt: As our new colleague you shall be responsible for the management, optimization, and stability of our regional Wide Area Network (WAN). Network Troubleshooting: To resolve cross-regional network connectivity issues in a timely and efficient manner. Documentation: To maintain accurate and up-to-date network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, and procedures. To create and maintain knowledge base articles for common network issues. Experience: 3+ years of experience in network engine
eligibility_evidence: This position in alignment with international team and service owner involves managing Internet Service Provider (ISP) connections, negotiating contracts, resolving network connectivity issues, and optimizing the global network architecture.
The job shall be hybrid in one of Danfoss offices - Poland (Grodzisk Mazowiecki), Bulgaria (Sofia), Slovakia (Povazska Bystrica), Romania (Bucharest).

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Experience: 3+ years of experience in network engineering, with a focus on WAN management.
